rows.en: You've got skill.
Hm, you were even better than before.
Your skill as a pilot is considerable.
I can watch you fight without worry.
I haven't cleared you to sortie yet, you know.
rows.notes: Direction inferred: Max scolding a partner who launched early.

rows.en: This battle is a dangerous gamble.
Please fulfill your responsibility.
Be very careful, now.
rows.notes: 'gure-gure mo' read as 'kure-gure mo' (be very careful).

rows.en: Watch the enemy closely.
This is a mission. Do it right.
Do your duty proud.
I know the risks. Let's go.
No failures. I'm counting on you.
I'm here. Don't worry.
Sorry, but I'll be relying on you.
You and I together will finish this quickly.
Almost there, but not quite.
You don't belong on a battlefield.
I can't help but call it luck that you're even safe.
We somehow pulled through.
Your help next time, please.
Now, shall we head back?
Take a good long break when you get back.
Was my support of any use to you?
Your skill wasn't bad.
Your skill rivals Milia's.
I'm surrounded by excellent female pilots.
You fought like a true genius.
There's no need for me to step in.
Milia, let's show them our timeless teamwork!
Something's off. Stay on guard.
rows.notes: 'kono kanji' (this feeling) paraphrased.

rows.en: My genius title is on the line.
rows.notes: 'tensai no na ga tsuyosugiru' makes no sense; guessed a 'name of genius is at stake' sense.

rows.en: Seems you're not yet at my level.
rows.notes: Addressee (enemy) inferred from Milia's matching clip 617.

rows.en: I can't grasp the situation. Open all video feeds. All of them.
We may need to shell down.
rows.notes: 'sheru daun' (shell down) is a game/series term not in the glossary; kept literal.

rows.en: Eyes on the monitor!
Audio on a good line. Shell down!
rows.notes: Words 'ii kaisen' (good line) may be 'ichi kaisen' (one line); 'shell down' not in glossary.

rows.en: Who told you to shell off? Shell down!
rows.notes: Whisper wrote 'seru' for 'sheru'.

rows.en: Shell on now, shell down meanwhile.
rows.notes: 'sheru on / sheru down' not in glossary.

rows.en: Stand down. Recover each unit's survivors and return them.
We are currently threatened by an unidentified enemy.
We'll hold realistic drills. Use them in the battles ahead.
Diamond Force is also taking part in the drills.
I'm counting on you all.
Moving to rescue City 7 now.
Beginning transformation.
Macross Cannon, fire!
All ships, launch Valkyrie squadrons. Vanguard ships, ready to fire.
rows.notes: 'zen-eikan' is written with the kanji for 'all'; read as 'zen-ei-kan' (vanguard ships), as in the second take.

rows.en: Recall Emerald Force and Diamond Force at once.
rows.notes: 'hoosu' (horse) read as 'foosu' (force).

rows.en: Emerald Force, sortie at once. All forces, take intercept positions.
rows.notes: 'hoosu' read as 'foosu' (force).

rows.en: That must be the leader unit. D1, wait for rear support.
rows.notes: 'Riwan' read as 'D1' (Diamond 1); 'kouhou' (PR) read as 'kouhou' (rear) support.

rows.en: No way... so this is the Protodeviln!
The Macross 7 fleet faces an unprecedented threat: the Protodeviln.
To counter this threat, we'll hold live drills with our newest gear.
Mayor Milia and I, Maximilian Jenius, will take part in this training.
We will raid and annihilate the Protodeviln base.
rows.notes: Whisper has the kanji for 'absorb'; probably 'raid' (same sound, kyuushuu).

rows.en: This is our operation: Operation Stargazer.
All units: annihilating the enemy is your absolute mission. Act swiftly.
The fate of the entire galaxy, not just Macross 7, rides on this operation.
Operation complete. All units, leave the atmosphere at once.
A rogue Meltrandi fleet! To think such a huge fleet still remained!
I am Maximilian Jenius, commander of the Macross 7 fleet, the U.N. Forces' 7th Emigrant Fleet.
Please, hear me out.
The Zentradi are walking the path of coexistence with us humans.
Over 100,000 Zentradi live in this fleet as well.
To prevent any more pointless fighting, I want to hold peace talks.
Shield destroyed? What of it? Don't worry.
rows.notes: Whose shield and who is being reassured is not stated.

rows.en: Just a graze? Nothing to worry about.
rows.notes: Same as 654.

rows.en: I can't fight anymore. What? Don't worry about it.
rows.notes: Pattern of 654-657 unclear (a two-voice exchange compressed into one clip).

rows.en: Looks like there was no need for me to step in. What? Never mind.
rows.notes: Same as 656.

rows.en: I'm taking the limiters off.
We may need to shell down.
rows.notes: 'sheru daun' not in glossary; second take of mac_621.

rows.en: Eyes on the monitor!
Audio on a good line. Shell down!
rows.notes: Second take of mac_623; 'kaisen' written as 'battle' kanji by Whisper.

rows.en: Who told you to shell off? Shell down!
rows.notes: Second take of mac_624.

rows.en: Shell on now, shell down meanwhile.
rows.notes: Second take of mac_625.

rows.en: Stand down. Recover each unit's survivors and return them.
rows.notes: 'kakudai seizonmono' read as 'kakutai seizonsha' (each unit's survivors).

rows.en: We'll hold realistic drills. Use them in the battles ahead.
rows.notes: Garbled 'ii' in the transcript; read as 'okonai' (conduct).

rows.en: Moving to rescue City 7 now.
rows.notes: 'shite 7' read as 'Shiti Sebun' (City 7).

rows.en: Macross Cannon, fire!
